name: Lulu
title: the Fae Sorceress

Q.name: Glitterlance
Q.description: Lulu and Pix each fire a piercing bolt dealing 60/95/130/165/200 + 0.5×AP magic damage and Slowing by 80%, decaying over 2 seconds. Enemies take (60/95/130/165/200 + 0.5×AP) × 0.5 magic damage from additional bolts.
Q.summary: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits.

W.name: Whimsy
W.description: When used on an ally, Lulu grants 0.25 + 0.001×AP Move Speed and 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% Attack Speed for 3/3.25/3.5/3.75/4 seconds. When used on an enemy, Lulu Polymorphs them for 1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2 seconds.
W.summary: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.

E.name: Help, Pix!
E.description: When used on an ally, Pix jumps to them and grants Pix, Faerie Companion for 6 seconds. If the ally is a champion, Pix also grants 70/110/150/190/230 + 0.5×AP Shield for 2.5 seconds. When used on an enemy champion, Pix hampers them, dealing 70/110/150/190/230 + 0.5×AP magic damage and granting True Sight of them for 4 seconds.
E.summary: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.

R.name: Wild Growth
R.description: Lulu enlarges an ally, Knocking Up surrounding enemies for 1 second. The enlarged ally gains 275/425/575 + 0.55×AP max Health and Slows surrounding enemies by 30/45/60% for 7 seconds.
R.summary: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.

Passive.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
Passive.description: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.
Passive.summary: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Enchanter support who polymorphs divers with W, shields allies with E, and saves her carry with R knock-up and bonus health. Wins fights by keeping her hyper-carry alive.
strengths: W polymorph (point-and-click) stops divers and assassins
R: bonus health and knock-up around the ally
E shield or slow, and moves Pix for long-range Q poke
W also gives allies move and attack speed
Strong poke lane with Pix Q
weaknesses: Weak to multiple divers or burst through R
profile.curveNote: Pokes from level 1 with Q + Pix attacks.

Passive.notes: Pix fires bolts after her attacks (blockable).

Q.notes: Lance from Lulu and Pix; slows.

W.notes: Point-and-click: enemy polymorph, or ally speed.

E.notes: Shield ally or damage enemy; Pix follows.

R.notes: Ally grows: bonus health, knock-up + slow around them.

profile.windowAgainst: W down: dive the carry. Burst through R window.
